text:
Eleni (Partner Mgmt): Quick sync ask — VaultGrid proposed a combined marketplace listing + joint announcement for their HSM + BYOK + SCIM/SSO integration. We need a compact onboarding checklist, security gating items, and a publishing/embargo plan. Who can take the lead? :wave:
Noah - Eng: I can drive the engineering checklist. High level needs: SAML IdP/SP metadata exchange, SCIM 2.0 provisioning (support bulk/import and PATCH), BYOK key wrap JWK/JWE endpoint, and attestation manifest (HSM model + FIPS certs). Also test harness for end-to-end.
Katherine (DevEx): I'll prep a tiny test harness and a runbook so customers can smoke-test provisioning + login flows. Recommend a public repo with sample IdP and SCIM mock.
Tomas (Marketing): We'll need partner-approved copy, co-branded imagery, and a co-hosted webinar slot. What's the target publish window?
Eleni (Partner Mgmt): VaultGrid suggested mid-June. Legal and security signoff are gating — proposed embargo to hold until everything's signed.
Priya (Legal): DPA + marketplace security addendum needed. Also we need to confirm data flows for SCIM and any customer-managed keys (BYOK) in the addendum. Expect 7 business days once docs are received.
SecBot: Security checklist (automated): vendor questionnaire submitted, pending manual review items: HSM attestation (2 items), crypto design doc (1), pen-test report (pending).
Noah - Eng: Minimal SCIM attribute map we require: userName, id/externalId, name.{givenName,familyName}, emails[type=work], active (boolean). PATCH for updates + bulk replace endpoints.
Noah - Eng: For BYOK we expect the partner to host an endpoint that returns wrapped_key material and metadata. Example (simplified):
```
# GET partner JWKs
curl https://vaultgrid.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json
# POST our BYOK wrap request
curl -X POST https://vaultgrid.example.com/api/v1/byok/request \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"key_alias":"redwood-customer-42","wrap_alg":"RSA-OAEP-256"}'
```
Katherine (DevEx): I'll scaffold the repo today and include a mock IdP (SAML), a SCIM provider, and a BYOK simulation. Will also document cert rotation test steps.
Tomas (Marketing): Drafting the co-sell 1-pager and a short press timeline. Suggest internal preview to partners 48h before embargo lift.
Priya (Legal): Please upload proposed DPA + security addendum to the shared folder. I'll queue review. Also ask VaultGrid to provide SOC2/pen-test and FIPS statements.
Eleni (Partner Mgmt): Creating shared folder now: /shared/partners/vaultgrid-marketplace. I'm adding a checklist sheet with owners and due dates.
Noah - Eng: Action items: provide SAML metadata sample, SCIM schema, BYOK endpoint contract, and acceptance tests. Target EOD Fri for initial artifacts.
Katherine (DevEx): Will open a PR for the test harness and add runbook steps.
Tomas (Marketing): Scheduling a creative review on Fri AM.
Priya (Legal): I'll start review once docs are there, ping me when DPA draft is uploaded.
SecBot: Reminder: attach vendor pen-test and crypto review to the folder.
Eleni (Partner Mgmt): Recap: Katherine -> test harness + runbook; Noah -> SCIM/SAML/BYOK specs + tests; Tomas -> marketing assets + embargo plan; Priya -> legal review; SecBot -> security review follow-up. Weekly sync proposed Tuesdays at 11am PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
